scope: Proposition 7.4 (Scalar equivalence) of the manuscript “The maximal triangular Hilbert transform at the symmetric point” (preprints/The-maximal-triangular-Hilbert-transform-at-the-symmetric-point-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 082 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9dbcf9cb984bcf7b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all complex G0, G1, G2 ∈ L3(ℝ2), every finite simplex truncation is absolutely integrable, and sup 0<ε<R<∞ |Λε,R(G0, G1, G2)| ≤ CM 2 ∏ v=0 ∥Gv∥3. Its joint scalar principal value exists for every such triple and is the unique bounded trilinear extension of its compact smooth definition. The optimal constants in the uniform flat and simplex scalar estimates are equal.
